messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 13(9)

Article 13 Obligations of importers of machinery and related products. 9. Importers shall, further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation, in paper or digital format, necessary to demonstrate conformity of the machinery or related products with this Regulation in a language that can be easily understood by that authority. Importers shall cooperate with that authority, at its request, on any action taken to eliminate the risks to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, to the environment presented by machinery or related products which they have placed on the market.

response.text:
Importers | mustProvideToAuthority | all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity of the machinery or related products with this Regulation | upon a reasoned request from a competent national authority | Importers shall, further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation
Importers | mustProvideDocumentsIn | paper or digital format | provided under a reasoned request from a competent national authority | in paper or digital format
Importers | mustProvideInLanguage | a language that can be easily understood by the requesting authority | provided under a reasoned request from a competent national authority | in a language that can be easily understood by that authority
Importers | mustCooperateWithAuthority | on any action taken to eliminate risks presented by machinery or related products they placed on the market | at the authority's request | Importers shall cooperate with that authority, at its request, on any action taken to eliminate the risks
Importers | cooperationCoversRisksTo | health and safety of persons | "" | the risks to the health and safety of persons
Importers | cooperationCoversRisksTo | domestic animals and property, and the environment | domestic animals and property where appropriate; environment where applicable | where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, to the environment
